requests.reply: {"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "New Hire Onboarding Guide"}, {"id": 1, "text": "Welcome to Moaro Logis."}, {"id": 2, "text": "This document walks you through what to do step by step during your first two weeks ▶"}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "For questions, please contact Manager Joonho Byun (Byun Joonho) in HR."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Seojin Um will help you with setting up your development environment."}, {"id": 2, "text": "First day"}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "When you arrive, first get your access badge at the front desk on the first floor."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "The access card I receive is registered by 변준호 매니저."}, {"id": 1, "text": "My seat is next to the dawn team, and 엄서진 also sits in the same row."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Lunch is eaten together with the team members."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Day Two"}, {"id": 1, "text": "On the second day, I spend the whole day on site."}, {"id": 2, "text": "I observe the unloading work wearing safety shoes."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "I don't speak to the driver first while he's working."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "The experience report goes up to the team leader for approval."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Once you've reviewed it, it will be passed on to Manager Byeon Jun-ho."}, {"id": 2, "text": "First week"}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "New Moaroji hires work through a task list called \"Launchpad\" in their first week."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Launchpad item 1 is logging into the wiki and signing up for the internal messenger."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Company-wide announcements and chitchat take place in the \"Hearth\" channel."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "I'll leave a short self-introduction in the Hearth channel."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Step 2 is to take the dispatch system guide training."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Make a full day's dispatch plan yourself as a guide."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Do not post practice screens in Hearth."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "You don't have to write a long report."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Once you finish the scaffolding, you start real work in the second week."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Your first real task is to get a code review together with Eom Seo-jin."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Code review results will be shared in the team channel of Modakbul."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "If you have any questions, feel free to ask Manager 변준호 at any time."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Finally, leave a one-line impression on 모닥불, and you're done."}]}
